metadata.title: [Model][SM70] DeepSeek-V4.1 indexer: fused SM70 prefill index scores (VLLM_V41_INDEX_FUSE, default off)
metadata.body:
Contributed by PLI Labs (Proprietary Legal Intelligence). Written with AI assistance (Claude Code).

**Depends on #1370** (PP2): this branch sits on it because both touch `attention_ops.py`'s indexer setup; the change itself does not use PP. Near our tiled-scorer PR #1372 and index-reduce PR #1386 in the same file; whichever lands later needs a small rebase.

## Purpose

At prefill, the lightning indexer (`select_packed_positions` -> `select_compressed_positions`) scores each all-reduce tile of R query rows as `torch.mm` -> `relu_` -> `mul_` -> `sum(1)`. That writes an [R, 8, N] fp16 tile once and reads it three times per rank (about 96 bytes per query-key pair), then runs one TP all-reduce and one top-k launch per tile. At long context this is a visible share of time to first token.

With **`VLLM_V41_INDEX_FUSE=<order>`** (default `0`, off):

- `benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41pidx/`: a small separate SM70 extension (own `torch.ops.v41pidx` namespace; `build.py`). `index_head_sum` computes the per-rank head sums of a block of whole tiles in one kernel: `mma.m8n8k4` scores held in registers, ReLU, weight and the 8-head FP32 sum, 2 bytes per pair written. Built with `--fmad=false`; every add and multiply is spelled with `__fadd_rn` / `__fmul_rn`.
- `vllm/models/deepseek_v41/index_fuse.py`: the knob parser and `select`. Every tile of a block goes through the same `all_reduce` call as today (same rows, shape and contents, so the same collective and the same bits), then one `index_topk` launch covers the block's rows. With `VLLM_V41_INDEX_OVERLAP=1` too, a block's reductions and top-k run on the overlap side stream while the next block is scored.
- `attention_ops.py`: `select_packed_positions` calls `_select_fused` when the knob is on (eager prefill only; it refuses under graph capture and requires `VLLM_V41_INDEX_TOPK=1`).
- `vllm/envs.py`: `VLLM_V41_INDEX_FUSE`, `VLLM_V41_INDEX_FUSE_LIB` (path of `v41pidx.so`, required when on) and `VLLM_V41_INDEX_FUSE_MB` (block budget, default 64 MiB), all with metadata.

**Exactness.** The selected index sets equal today's if and only if the kernel gives today's per-rank partial sums bit for bit. That depends on the order in which cuBLAS feeds K and on the FP32 order of PyTorch's `sum(1)` over 8 heads, both GPU facts. So the knob value names the head-sum order (`seq`, `ilp2`, `ilp4`, `tree`), and `benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41pidx/check.py` reports which orders match on the GPU at hand. A bad value or a missing library raises; nothing is guessed. Columns at or past the live key count are +0 here and uninitialized-key scores today, and top-k never reads them.

- `tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_index_fuse.py`: CPU tests (off loads nothing; registered defaults are off; knob and budget parsing; missing library refuses; block sizes are whole tiles; `select` issues today's all-reduce tiles and equals the per-tile reference top-k for one and several tiles per block).

## Test Plan

```bash
ruff check / ruff format --check   # ruff 0.14.0, changed .py files
python -m tools.generate_env_reference --check   # and the other four 1Cat reference checks
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= pytest -q tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_index_fuse.py tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_attention_ops.py tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_index_overlap.py
V41PIDX_BUILD_DIR=build python benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41pidx/build.py   # sm_70
python benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41pidx/check.py build/v41pidx.so          # one V100
```

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fused prefill index scores | DeepSeek-V4.1 packed index keys, fp16 q/w/keys, 8 heads per rank, dim 128 | SM70, eager prefill, `VLLM_V41_INDEX_TOPK=1`, knob on and library set | `index_fuse.select`; refuses (raises) under capture, without top-k or without the library | CPU tests; sm_70 build; GPU check on one V100 (bit-exact head sums, equal index rows); measured on 8x V100 PP2 x TP4 | TP other than 4 (8 heads per rank assumed); non-V100 SM70 parts |
| Decode | — | any | unchanged (prefill branch only) | source; measured decode neutral | — |
| Switch off | all | default | today's `select_compressed_positions`, nothing loads | CPU test | — |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

- Default enabled or opt-in: opt-in; `VLLM_V41_INDEX_FUSE` defaults to `0`.
- Required CLI options and environment switches: `VLLM_V41_INDEX_FUSE=ilp4` (the order our check and serving runs used), `VLLM_V41_INDEX_FUSE_LIB=<path>/v41pidx.so`, `VLLM_V41_INDEX_TOPK=1` (default).
- KV cache dtype used for the benchmark: the #1277 packed-KV default.
- Wheel SHA or source commit: measured on our build of the #1277 merge (`899e9ed33`) with the PP2 x TP4 port; this branch is the change alone on #1370, rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`.
- PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used: `v41pidx.so` from this tree.
- User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence: below. Activation logs one `V4.1 indexer: VLLM_V41_INDEX_FUSE=<order> ...` line per rank at import and one `v41pidx fused prefill select first call` line at the first long prefill.
- Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons: unchanged; refusals raise with the reason.
- Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility: no variable renamed or removed.
- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: three tuning variables with metadata; references pass.
- Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows: none.
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: +3 registered, 0 unregistered reads.

## Test Result

**MEASURED, 2026-11-04,** 8x V100-SXM2-32GB, DeepSeek-V4.1 PP2 x TP4, one request per prompt, two runs per arm, `ilp4` on vs off:

| Prompt | TTFT off (s) | TTFT on (s) | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 32K | — | — | +0.3 % (noise) |
| 150K | 85.1 / 86.2 | 81.3 / 81.6 | **-4.9 %** |
| 300K | 174.1 / 176.8 | 159.0 / 158.4 | **-9.5 %** |

Output identical between arms; decode neutral (+0.015 ms per round).

**Re-run for this PR, 2026-11-05,** on this branch (on #1370, rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`):

- sm_70 build of `v41pidx.so` from this tree: OK.
- `check.py` on one V100-SXM2: all four orders give 0 head-sum mismatches against `torch.mm -> relu_ -> mul_ -> sum(1)` (two shapes, up to 9000 keys); `index_fuse.select` vs `select_compressed_positions` (identity all-reduce, one rank), five shapes from 300 to 2000 rows, 2048 to 9000 keys and 1 to 5 tiles per block, every order: 0 rows differ.
- pytest, the three files above, CPU only: 21 passed, 10 skipped (CUDA-only attention-op cases).
- the five 1Cat reference checks: all pass; ruff 0.14.0 `check` and `format --check`: pass.

Not re-run: multi-GPU (TP all-reduce) runs, timing and serving.

---
